title: H-MERGERSTOCK-2 follow-up (review MEDIUM-2): a deposit into an ABSENT merged owner's shop is applied by the machine standing in for that owner. Three members (melaus + Client1 from the fixture, Client2 grown in); Client1 drops, the host stands in (a member host always simulates), and the THIRD member Client2 hand-deposits into Client1's fast food. Before the fix the host forwarded the op to the offline owner, SendHubTo logged 'not connected' and dropped it - the depositor kept the goods and nothing landed. NO save.
preconditions: Reporter fixture fx-hq1 (MERGED pair melaus + Client1; vars.keepMerger true so tools/regress.py resets it with --keep-merger). Client1 owns the fast food at vars.shop (11 ba:street_tenthavenue - a staffed till, per t-shopday-paper-till). The third instance (role d, PlayerId Client2) has no slot in fx-hq1 and joins as a NEW player (charconfirm armed before hostload). Dev build with merge / mergestatus / absence / regstate / helperstate / stationroom / deposit / stockof / enterbuilding / exitbuilding. The host is a company member, so HostReconcileAbsence designates the HOST as the stand-in (MPServer ~:823) - this run proves the host-applies branch of RouteStorageOpForAbsentOwner; the forward-to-a-client-stand-in branch needs a company the host is NOT in plus a fourth member (three clients) and is not exercised here.
